title: Watch Collector - no BS display on Notification Panel
body:
Hello,
When my SW3 is running as a collector the BS is not displayed in the Notifications Panel of the phone. When the phone is the collector the BS graph appear between notificstions. 

Is this a bug or there is a way to activate this from within the Settings?
